def test_auth_signup_and_login():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "password123"

    # Signup
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/auth/signup"), json={"user": username, "password": password}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    token = resp.json().get("token")
    assert token is not None

    # Login
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/auth/login"), json={"user": username, "password": password}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    login_token = resp.json().get("token")
    assert login_token is not None

    # Get user info
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {login_token}"}
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/user/me"), headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("user") == username

def test_wallet_topup_and_balance():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "password123"

    # Signup
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/auth/signup"), json={"user": username, "password": password}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    token = resp.json().get("token")
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}

    # Initial balance
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    wallet_info = resp.json()
    assert wallet_info.get("balance") == 0
    address = wallet_info.get("address")
    assert address is not None

    # Topup
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup"), headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    topup_info = resp.json()
    assert topup_info.get("balance") > 0
    assert topup_info.get("address") == address
    new_balance = topup_info.get("balance")

    # Verify balance
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("balance") == new_balance

    # Topup again (conflict/error)
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup"), headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_wallet_transfer_success():
    # User A
    user_a = f"usera_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    resp_a = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/auth/signup"), json={"user": user_a, "password": "pwd"}, timeout=10)
    assert resp_a.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_a.status_code}: {resp_a.text}"
    token_a = resp_a.json().get("token")
    headers_a = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_a}"}

    # User B
    user_b = f"userb_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    resp_b = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/auth/signup"), json={"user": user_b, "password": "pwd"}, timeout=10)
    assert resp_b.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_b.status_code}: {resp_b.text}"
    token_b = resp_b.json().get("token")
    headers_b = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_b}"}

    # Topup A
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup"), headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    balance_a = resp.json().get("balance")

    # Get B's address
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_b = resp.json().get("address")
    balance_b = resp.json().get("balance")

    # Transfer A -> B
    transfer_amount = 1 if balance_a >= 1 else balance_a

    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), headers=headers_a, json={"to": address_b, "amount": transfer_amount}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("balance") == balance_a - transfer_amount

    # Verify B's balance
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("balance") == balance_b + transfer_amount

def test_wallet_transfer_failures():
    # User A
    user_a = f"usera_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    resp_a = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/auth/signup"), json={"user": user_a, "password": "pwd"}, timeout=10)
    assert resp_a.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_a.status_code}: {resp_a.text}"
    token_a = resp_a.json().get("token")
    headers_a = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_a}"}

    # User B
    user_b = f"userb_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    resp_b = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/auth/signup"), json={"user": user_b, "password": "pwd"}, timeout=10)
    assert resp_b.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp_b.status_code}: {resp_b.text}"
    token_b = resp_b.json().get("token")
    headers_b = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_b}"}

    # Get B's address
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_b = resp.json().get("address")

    # Transfer without topup (insufficient funds)
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), headers=headers_a, json={"to": address_b, "amount": 10}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Topup A
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup"), headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Transfer negative amount
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), headers=headers_a, json={"to": address_b, "amount": -5}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Transfer missing required field
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), headers=headers_a, json={"amount": 1}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Transfer to non-existent address
    fake_address = f"fake_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), headers=headers_a, json={"to": fake_address, "amount": 1}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_auth_unauthorized_access():
    # Attempt to access protected endpoints without a token
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/user/me"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), json={"to": "some_address", "amount": 10}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
